context: After restoring the blocked liquidity controller, live pool data worked but wallet-dependent entry controls still appeared frozen. The sidebar Wallet control was only a navigation anchor, Preview was disabled solely because the wallet was disconnected, and XRBitcoin used generic busy state instead of the dedicated connecting state used by the XRBC reference flow.
repair: Added #walletShortcut as a real Xaman authorization entry point instead of a scroll-only Wallet link.
Added dedicated S.connecting state matching the established XRBC connection lifecycle.
Connect button and shortcut expose Connecting / connected state and block duplicate authorization attempts.
Preview remains actionable while disconnected when other prerequisites are satisfied; its click opens authorization only and does not create a transaction payload.
After connection, Preview requires a separate deliberate click to build the unsigned transaction preview.
Runtime-contract verification now requires walletShortcut and executable binding on xrbitcoin-links.html.

walletShortcut.connected: Wallet connected -> scrolls to wallet panel

preserve: Exact XRB/XRP pool identity and validated ledger reads.
Pending and ambiguous Xaman request protections.
Validated XRPL finality and critical-field comparison.
